status: Experimental transaction V4 verified; all 17 release gates passed
scope: Atomic heading transaction request persistence and independent-context replay; not a complete saved session

contract.binding: Exact process-local base context, durable schema selector/fingerprint and base lineage/revision
contract.admission: Borrowed raw operation count before any owned operation reconstruction, then per-payload preflight and validation
contract.bounds: Outer JSON bytes, host operation count, individual fragment budgets and full-document application budgets
contract.errors: Indexed typed operation failures; first-excess count is a lower bound
contract.editorValues: V3 selection relocation/update, typed pending-format update and metadata contracts retained
contract.atomicity: Late guard, result-budget or final editor-value failure publishes no preceding changes
contract.legacyCompatibility: V1-V3 unchanged and reject V4; paragraph request bytes differ only in the explicitly selected envelope version

verification.focusedCommand: PROPTEST_CASES=10000 PROPTEST_RNG_SEED=20261003 cargo test -p breditor-core --lib --all-features --locked json_v4
coverage: Sequential source guards and deterministic encoding
Independent context and independently decoded Editor State V3 base
Exact selection, typed pending formats and one-unit undo/redo
Stale snapshot admission precedes payload interpretation
Late stale guard preserves the state and retained redo branch
Later full-result property-budget failure rolls back preceding valid edits
Invalid final selection or pending-format combination rejects atomically
Zero, exact and exceeded operation budgets; exact JSON byte boundaries
Unknown/duplicate fields, wrong versions and nested operation envelopes rejected
Empty, state-only, Merge, Ignore and net-zero content history semantics
Legacy transaction, commit and session codecs remain closed
verification.rustLint: Workspace all-target all-feature Clippy passed with warnings denied
verification.rustdoc: Workspace all-feature documentation passed with warnings denied
verification.packageConsumers: Direct/path-aliased reproducibility and isolated/clean-reference package consumers passed

limitations: No V4 session checkpoint, commit or local-log format yet
Transaction persistence does not retain a whole session's history cursor or undo/redo branches
No heading-aware typing, Enter/delete behavior, browser projection or toolbar exposure
No fresh native Safari system-clipboard, native Chrome or iOS qualification
The browser regression pass is not a claim that the WebKit engine itself was repaired
